body: After release 4.2 the Android client cleared its encrypted preferences during migration, so every user was signed out. Migrate the keystore entry before touching preferences.
title: Session tokens wiped by the Android upgrade

body: Our notification worker batched pushes per hour to save quota; customers received gate-change alerts long after the change. Send time-critical pushes immediately.
title: Delayed notifications from batching

body: Turnstile scanners failed on tickets whose QR code was rendered at small size with brand colours. Render codes black on white at a minimum of 300 pixels.
title: Scanners rejected low-contrast codes

body: A timeout during refund made the client retry and the provider refunded the card again. Send an idempotency key with every refund request.
title: Duplicate refund on retry

body: With airplane mode on, the home screen dereferenced a missing cached response and the app crashed. Show cached tickets and a banner when offline.
title: No network means a crash at launch

body: Card payments and refunds are processed by one payment provider, chosen for its wallet support; there is no fallback provider.
title: Payments go through a single provider

body: Map tiles failed to render on devices still running iOS 15 because the vector style used a newer expression. Ship a raster fallback style for old iPhones.
title: Venue maps empty on iOS 15

body: Choosing seats in a 60,000-seat stadium froze the screen because every seat was a separate view. Draw the seat plan on one canvas and hit-test taps.
title: Stadium seat selection lag

body: The Polish locale shipped half in English because the translation export ran before the last batch arrived. Block the release when any locale is incomplete.
title: Polish strings absent from release

body: Keeping location updates on in the background for venue arrival detection cost users a fifth of their battery per day. Use geofences instead.
title: Location tracking drained phones

body: The purchase control was an image without a label, so screen readers skipped it. Every tappable control needs an accessibility label.
title: Purchase control invisible to VoiceOver

body: Release builds stopped signing after the certificate on the CI runner expired. Renew certificates a month early and alert on expiry.
title: Code signing broke on the build server

body: Order records are kept for seven years for tax purposes, then deleted; the app shows the last two years.
title: Order history retention

body: Fans travelling to concerts abroad saw start times in their home time zone. Always show event times in the venue's local zone and say so.
title: Event times shown in the phone's zone

body: Apple rejected the build because the membership screen did not show the renewal price and terms. Show price, period and cancellation terms.
title: Subscription paywall failed app review

body: The reset email linked to a token valid for one minute; most people opened it later. Make reset links valid for an hour and single use.
title: Password reset links expired instantly

body: In dark mode the ticket barcode was drawn light on dark and gate readers could not decode it. Force a white panel behind barcodes.
title: Barcode invisible on dark backgrounds

body: A misconfigured default in the flag service enabled an unfinished checkout for all users. Defaults must be off and changes need review.
title: Flag service default turned features on globally

body: Searching for 'Café Olé' returned nothing because the index stored names unnormalised. Fold diacritics in both the index and the query.
title: Accented venue names never matched

body: The analytics client resent events after a timeout and the backend counted both. Give each event an id and deduplicate on ingest.
title: Retries inflated analytics

body: Event poster images were cached forever and filled storage on small phones. Cap the cache at 200 MB.
title: Image cache grows without bound

body: We support Android 9 and newer; older versions lack the keystore features we rely on.
title: Minimum supported Android version is 9

body: Links shared from the web opened the event list instead of the event because the router ignored the path. Route deep links by event id.
title: Deep links opened the wrong event

body: When an event moved, passes in the phone wallet kept the old date. Push wallet pass updates on every change.
title: Wallet passes need updating after reschedules

body: Crash reports strip emails, names and payment details before upload.
title: Crash reporting excludes personal data

body: Fans asked how long the entry queue was; we now estimate wait from scan rates.
title: Large venues need queue estimates

body: The seat hold countdown reset when the app went to background. Keep the hold timer on the server.
title: Checkout timer confused buyers

body: Sales logs suggest two thirds of tickets for popular events sell within an hour of release.
title: Most purchases happen in the first hour of sale

body: The presale queue endpoint was hammered by refreshes; rate limit per device.
title: Rate limit the presale queue

body: At the largest accessibility text size the ticket details overlapped. Test layouts at every dynamic type size.
title: Font scaling broke the ticket layout

body: Mobile releases go out every second Tuesday unless a hotfix is needed.
title: Releases ship every two weeks

body: Some venue networks blocked the API's domain; tickets must be viewable fully offline.
title: Venue Wi-Fi blocks our API domain

body: Receipts were always in English; send them in the language the order was placed in.
title: Email receipts in the buyer's language

body: Transferred tickets kept the original owner's name on the pass. Reissue the pass on transfer.
title: Transfer of tickets between friends

body: Wrapping the mobile site in a web view was rejected: offline tickets and wallet integration were unreliable.
title: Building the app with a web view
